provider_assertions: Completed provider result settles canonical worker job once and releases reservation/capacity
Duplicate result does not create another terminal event
Expired poll lease is reclaimed with a new token; stale observation cannot settle; current observation succeeds
Cancellation/completion race yields exactly one valid terminal outcome and releases capacity
Expired outbox publisher cannot cancel the newer live dispatch; one DISPATCHED event remains.
Stale worker completion/failure cannot duplicate the retry outbox or terminal settlement; current attempt settles once.
restart_assertion: Task Control continuity test kills an attempt process, recovers the lease, schedules retry, and reconstructs the same task/job group identity from PostgreSQL. It is a TeamRun/Task Control test; it does not prove DevelopmentRun Final Verify across process restart.
known_gaps: Provider test uses a deterministic synthetic provider observation, not a live provider submission/API.
The dedicated SPEC-224 Runner continuation PostgreSQL child-process suite still uses the retired-for-this-task Docker fixture, so it was not run here.

Task Control continuity test writes a synthetic finalVerification projection marker; it is not SPEC-224 Final Verify evidence.
